description_en: Creates an ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance
description_zh: 创建云消息队列RabbitMQ的实例
kebab_example: aliyun amqp-open create-instance --payment-type Subscription --vpc-id vpc-xxx --vswitch-ids vsw-xxx --security-group-id sg-xxx --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateInstance

parameters.help_en: The client token
parameters.help_zh: 客户端Token
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
Subscription: subscription.
PayAsYouGo: Serverless
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型，取值如下：
Subscription：预付费系列
PayAsYouGo ： Serverless系列
parameters.name: payment_type

parameters.help_en:
The subscription period. Unit: periodCycle.

This parameter is valid only when PaymentType is set to Subscription. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
预付费周期，单位：periodCycle。

当 PaymentType 为 Subscription 时，该参数有效，默认值为1
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription period. Valid values:
Month: month.
Year: year.

This parameter is valid only when PaymentType is set to Subscription. Default value: Month
parameters.help_zh:
预付费周期单位，取值如下：
Month：月
Year：年

当PaymentType为Subscription时，该参数有效，默认值为Month
parameters.name: period_cycle

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:
true: enables auto-renewal.
false: disables auto-renewal
parameters.help_zh:
续费方式，取值如下：
true：自动续费
false：手动续费
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The auto-renewal period. Unit: the value of RenewalDurationUnit. Default value: Month.

This parameter is valid only when AutoRenew is set to true. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费周期，单位 RenewalDurationUnit 值，默认为：月。

当 AutoRenew 为 true 时，该参数有效，默认值为1
parameters.name: auto_renew_period

parameters.help_en:
The renewal status. This parameter is equivalent to autoRenew. You need to configure only one of them. Valid values:
AutoRenewal: enables auto-renewal.

Both autoRenew and renewStatus specify the renewal method. If both are specified, renewStatus takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
续费状态,等同于 autoRenew ，二选1 配置即可，取值如下：
AutoRenewal: 自动续费

和renewStatus都是续费方式，当两个同时填写时，以renewStatus为准
parameters.name: renew_status

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the auto-renewal period. Valid values:
Month: month.
Year: year
parameters.help_zh:
自动续费周期单位，取值如下：
Month：月
Year：年
parameters.name: renewal_duration_unit

parameters.help_en:
The instance edition. 
Valid values for subscription instances:
professional: Professional Edition.
enterprise: Enterprise Edition.
vip: Platinum Edition.

For Serverless instances, you do not need to specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
实例规格类型，
预付费系列的取值如下：
professional：专业版
enterprise：企业版
vip：铂金版

Serverless系列实例：无需填写
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The billing type of the Serverless instance. Valid values:
onDemand: pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
Serverless系列实例的计费类型，取值如下：
onDemand：按量累计
parameters.name: serverless_charge_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the instance. The name can be up to 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 实例名称。建议长度不超过64个字符
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The private network TPS traffic. Unit: transactions per second.

Refer to the values provided on the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ buy page (https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ons_onsproxy_pre)
parameters.help_zh:
私网TPS流量，单位：次/秒。

请根据 “云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版-购买页 (https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ons_onsproxy_pre)” 所给出的取值设置
parameters.name: max_private_tps

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable Internet access. Valid values:
true: enables Internet access.
false: disables Internet access
parameters.help_zh:
是否支持公网，取值如下：
true：支持公网
false：不支持公网
parameters.name: support_eip

parameters.help_en:
The peak Internet TPS traffic. Unit: TPS.

Refer to the values provided on the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ buy page (https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ons_onsproxy_pre)
parameters.help_zh:
公网网TPS流量峰值，单位：TPS。

请根据 “云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版-购买页 (https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ons_onsproxy_pre)” 所给出的取值设置
parameters.name: max_eip_tps

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of queues that can be created.

Refer to the values provided on the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ buy page (https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ons_onsproxy_pre)
parameters.help_zh:
配置Queue的数量，单位：个。

请根据 “云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版-购买页 (https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ons_onsproxy_pre)” 所给出的取值设置
parameters.name: queue_capacity

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of connections.

Refer to the values provided on the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ buy page (https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ons_onsproxy_pre)
parameters.help_zh:
最大连接数。

请根据 “云消息队列 RabbitMQ 版-购买页 (https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=ons_onsproxy_pre)” 所给出的取值设置
parameters.name: max_connections

parameters.help_en:
The log broker storage space. Unit: GB. Valid values:
Professional Edition and Enterprise Edition instances: fixed at 0.

A value of 0 indicates that no storage fees are charged for Professional Edition and Enterprise Edition instances, rather than indicating that no storage space is available.

Platinum Edition instances: m × 100, where m ranges from 7 to 28
parameters.help_zh:
配置消息存储空间，单位： GB，取值如下：
专业版实例和企业版实例：固定为0。

取值为0表示专业版和企业版实例不收取存储费用，而非没有存储空间。

铂金版实例：m×100，其中m的取值范围为[7,28]
parameters.name: storage_size

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the message tracing feature. Valid values:
true: enables the message tracing feature.
false: disables the message tracing feature.

Platinum Edition instances provide the message tracing feature free of charge for 15 days. You can only enable this feature and set the retention period to 15 days.
For instances of other editions, you can enable or disable the message tracing feature
parameters.help_zh:
是否开通消息轨迹功能，取值如下：
true：开通消息轨迹功能
false：不开通消息轨迹功能

铂金版实例免费提供15天消息轨迹功能，轨迹功能只能选择开启且轨迹保存时长只能设置为15天。
其他规格类型实例可选择开启或关闭轨迹功能
parameters.name: support_tracing

parameters.help_en:
The retention period of message traces. Unit: days. Valid values:
3: 3 days.
7: 7 days.
15: 15 days.

This parameter is valid only when SupportTracing is set to true
parameters.help_zh:
配置消息轨迹的保存时长，单位：天，取值如下：
3：3天
7：7天
15：15天

当SupportTracing为true时，该参数有效
parameters.name: tracing_storage_time

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: This feature is exclusive to dedicated instances. Specifies whether to enable the data storage encryption feature for the instance
parameters.help_zh: 独享实例专属功能。实例是否开通数据存储加密功能
parameters.name: encrypted_instance

parameters.help_en:
This feature is exclusive to dedicated instances. You must specify this parameter when EncryptedInstance is set to true. The ID of the Key Management Service (KMS) key used for data encryption storage. The key must meet the following requirements:

It cannot be a service key.

The key must be in the active state.

It must be a symmetric key, not an asymmetric key.

The key usage must be encryption and decryption.

If the KMS key expires or is deleted, data read and write operations become unavailable, and the ApsaraMQ for RabbitMQ instance experiences failures
parameters.help_zh:
独享实例专属功能，当EncryptedInstance为true时需要填写此字段。 数据加密存储使用的KMS密钥ID。 对密钥有以下要求：

不能是服务密钥；

密钥状态必须是开启的；

必须是对称密钥，不能是非对称密钥；

密钥用途必须是加解密；

KMS密钥过期/删除后，数据读写不可用，RabbitMQ实例异常；
parameters.name: kms_key_id

parameters.help_en: The provisioned TPS capacity for provisioned and elastic instances
parameters.help_zh: 预留+弹性实例的预留TPS容量
parameters.name: provisioned_capacity

parameters.help_en:
The deployment architecture of the Serverless instance. Valid values:

shared: shared architecture, applicable to provisioned and elastic (shared) instances and pay-as-you-go instances.

dedicated: dedicated architecture, applicable to provisioned and elastic (dedicated) instances
parameters.help_zh:
Serverless实例部署架构，取值如下：

shared: 共享架构，适用预留+弹性（共享）以及按量付费版本。

dedicated：独享架构，适用预留+弹性（独享）版本
parameters.name: edition

parameters.help_en: The resource tags
parameters.help_zh: 资源标签
parameters.name: tags

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC specified by the user, which is used to create a PrivateLink endpoint
parameters.help_zh: 用户指定vpcId，用于创建PVL接入点
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The IDs of the vSwitches used to create a PrivateLink endpoint when you create the instance.

You must specify two vSwitches that belong to different zones, except for regions that have only one zone.

The vSwitches must belong to the specified VPC.
 
The vSwitches must be in the Available state.

Each vSwitch must have at least 20 available IP addresses.

The zones to which the vSwitches belong must support the creation of Network Load Balancer (NLB) instances
parameters.help_zh:
创建实例时，用于创建privateLink接入点。

必须为两个，且属于不同可用区（除个别单可用区地域外）；

vswitch需要属于指定的VPC；
 
vswitch状态需要为Available；

vswitch中可用IP个数不能少于20；

vswitch所属可用区必须支持创建NLB；
parameters.name: vswitch_ids

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the security group used to create a PrivateLink endpoint.

Add an inbound access control policy that allows TCP traffic to destination ports 5672 and 5671.

Managed security groups are not supported.

The security group must belong to the specified VPC
parameters.help_zh:
指定安全组，用于创建privatelink接入点。

访问策略增加运行入方向写协议类型为TCP,目的地端口为5672, 5671的策略；

不支持托管安全组；

安全组需要属于指定的VPC；
parameters.name: security_group_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable only TLS-encrypted transmission ports for the instance. This parameter is supported only for provisioned and elastic (dedicated) instances and Platinum Edition instances
parameters.help_zh: 指定实例是否只开通TLS加密传输端口。此参数仅在（独享）预留+弹性、铂金实例支持
parameters.name: listener_mode

parameters.help_en: The authentication mode. Default value: RAM authentication mode
parameters.help_zh: 鉴权模式，默认Ram鉴权模式
parameters.name: auth_model

parameters.help_en: The elasticity switch
parameters.help_zh: 弹性开关
parameters.name: serverless_switch

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success

Data.description_en: The ID of the created instance

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. This parameter is a common parameter. Each request has a unique ID, which can be used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的，可用于排查和定位问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
